name: Wohns et al. 2022 (earlier tsdate algorithms) and Pope et al. 2026 (variational_gamma default from v0.2)
use_en: Wohns et al.: unified genealogy of modern and ancient humans; citation for tsdate inside_outside / maximization. From tsdate v0.2 the default is variational_gamma and should be cited as Pope et al. 2026 (doi:10.64898/2026.01.07.698223; abstract opened 2026-11-15 CST, full text not downloaded).
use_zh: 现代和古代人类的统一谱系；古代样本用来约束并给关系定年。tsdate README 把这篇当作原始算法文献。人类数据，不是葡萄。
note: Full text PMC10027547. README citation paragraph opened in v1; v2 distinguishes the two papers.

name: SINGER (Deng, Nielsen and Song 2025)
use_en: Posterior sampling of ARGs with uncertainty; applied to 1000 Genomes British and African individuals. The tool was already in the catalogue without this DOI.
use_zh: 从后验抽样 ARG 并量化不确定性；文中用于 1000 Genomes 的英国和非洲个体。目录里已有该工具，此前没有这篇 DOI。

name: Brandt et al. 2024 ARG review
use_en: Review: The Promise of Inferring the Past Using the Ancestral Recombination Graph.
note: Full text PMC10834162. Numerical benchmarks not copied here.

name: hap-IBD
use_en: IBD and HBD segments in phased genotype data; UK Biobank and simulation benchmarks in the abstract. Not run on Vitis here.
use_zh: 在已分相基因型上检测 IBD 和 HBD 片段；摘要中的比较来自 UK Biobank 和模拟。此处未在葡萄上运行。
note: Abstract only (AJHG XML stub). README opened.

name: RaPID2
use_en: Parallel PBWT framework for IBD segment detection.
use_zh: 用并行 PBWT 检测 IBD 片段。
note: Full text PMC13049448. Not run on Vitis here.

name: RZooRoH 2026 update
use_en: Update of the RZooRoH package already listed in the catalogue, covering inbreeding, IBD and relatedness.
use_zh: 目录中已有 RZooRoH；这是 2026 年更新，覆盖近交、IBD 和亲缘。

cluster: Local ancestry and spatial structure (2026-11-15 additions)
name: FLARE
ver_src: paper abstract + GitHub README, opened 2026-11-15 CST
use_en: Fast local ancestry inference (paper title). README: reference panel should not normally contain admixed samples; map= required; genotypes phased with no missing alleles. Hard to meet in Vitis because of introgression. Accuracy numbers not copied (AJHG XML had no body).
use_zh: 快速局部祖源推断（论文题名）。因 AJHG 正文未提供，不转写精度数字。
inp: phased genotypes, genetic map, unadmixed reference panel
note: Abstract only (AJHG XML stub). README opened. v2 adds reference-panel and map requirements from the opened README.

cluster: Local ancestry and spatial structure (2026-11-15 additions)
name: MOSAIC (Salter-Townshend and Myers 2019)
use_en: Fine-scale ancestry segments without prior knowledge of admixing groups.
use_zh: 在事先不知道混合来源群体的情况下推断细尺度祖源片段。

cluster: Local ancestry and spatial structure (2026-11-15 additions)
name: Marcus et al. 2021 (FEEMS paper)
use_en: FEEMS is a faster relative of EEMS for effective migration surfaces; applied to North American gray wolves. The FEEMS tool was already in the catalogue without this DOI. The original EEMS article was not independently fetched.
use_zh: FEEMS 是 EEMS 的更快相关方法，文中用于北美灰狼。目录里已有 FEEMS 工具，此前没有这篇 DOI。EEMS 原文本组教学章节打开的来源中未单独打开。

name: Ebler et al. 2022 (PanGenie paper)
use_en: Short-read genotyping of variants in a pangenome graph from k-mer counts and a panel of known, fully assembled haplotypes.
use_zh: 基于泛基因组、覆盖很广变异类型的基因分型。目录里已有该工具，此前没有这篇 DOI。
note: Full text PMC9005351. README opened. v2 input wording from the opened README.

name: Sirén et al. 2021 (Giraffe / pangenome genotyping)
use_en: Pangenomics enables genotyping of known structural variants in 5,202 diverse genomes. The vg tool was already in the catalogue without this DOI.
use_zh: 用泛基因组在 5,202 个多样基因组中对已知结构变异分型。目录里已有 vg，此前没有这篇 DOI。

name: Martin et al. 2019 PRS disparities
use_en: Human clinical PRS are several times more accurate in European-ancestry individuals. Included only as a caution for transferring scores across populations, not as a grape result.
use_zh: 人类临床 PRS 在欧洲祖源中准确性高出数倍。只作为跨群体迁移分数的提醒，不是葡萄结果。
note: Full text PMC6563838. Human, not grape.

name: Three open questions in PGS portability (2026)
use_en: Measures human PGS accuracy as a function of genetic distance to the GWAS sample. Not a grape paper. A grape PGS-transfer study was not opened for these chapters [待确认].
use_zh: 把人类 PGS 精度看成与 GWAS 样本遗传距离的函数。不是葡萄论文。本组教学章节打开的来源中未打开葡萄 PGS 迁移研究 [待确认]。

name: Jiang et al. 2025 Arabidopsis genetic load and climate
use_en: In 1,115 Arabidopsis accessions, Ne is a major correlational contributor (74-94%) of genetic-load variation. First author is Jiang J, not Zhang. Not a grape paper.
use_zh: 1,115 份拟南芥中，Ne 可解释 74-94% 的遗传负荷变异。不是葡萄论文。葡萄负荷结果用已在目录中的 Zhou 等 2017。
note: First author corrected in v2 (EuropePMC: Jiang J, Chen JF, Li XT, Wang L, Mao JF, Wang BS, Guo YL).

name: Ulmus elongata load and demography (2025)
use_en: Endangered relict tree; demography, genetic load and local adaptation. Abstract only. Not grape.
use_zh: 濒危残遗树的人口史、遗传负荷和局域适应。仅摘要。不是葡萄。

cluster: Public Vitis resequencing or genotyping panels (2026-11-15 additions)
name: North American Vitis introgression and parallel adaptation (2026)
use_en: 639 accessions, 48 Vitis species; popgen on 19 species; introgression ~14% of the average Vitis genome.
use_zh: 639 份、48 个种；对 19 个种做群体遗传；渗入约占平均 Vitis 基因组的 14%。

cluster: Public Vitis resequencing or genotyping panels (2026-11-15 additions)
name: Population structure of wild and cultivated grapevines in Armenia (2026)
use_en: Re-analysis of 164 Armenian accessions from a previous worldwide collection; wild vs cultivated separation; three cultivated components; split ~18.5k years ago, intensifying ~4k years ago (this study's estimates).
use_zh: 重新分析此前收集中的 164 份亚美尼亚材料；野生与栽培分开；栽培有三个成分；约 1.85 万年前开始分开，约 4 千年前加强（该研究的估计）。
